verdicts.reason: Both have the same structural flaw: the building photo no longer bleeds off the left edge. It sits inside a white strip of about 100 px and stops at a hard edge, with a faint panel edge on the right near x=625, so the layout reads as a shrunk, centred copy rather than a full-bleed banner. A keeps the headline closer to the original's scale and right anchor. B's headline is noticeably smaller and drifts inward, leaving more dead space on the right and weakening the main message, which makes it the slightly worse resize.
